page_title: LEV 2-1 HOF | Bayer Leverkusen v Hoffenheim 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+1' 2 - 1 Goal! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Nathan Tella. The score is 2:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' 1 - 1 Gooal! Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Jonathan Tah. He makes it 1:1.
88' A great pass puts Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hit his shot off the crossbar.
86' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Edmond Tapsoba and he is replaced by Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Jeremie Frimpong.
83' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul and Deniz Aytekin immediately signals a free kick.
82' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the left post.
80' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
79' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
79' The attendance is 30047.
78' Wout Weghorst will be replaced by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
76' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
75' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
75' Oliver Baumann pulls off a great save to deny Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Maximilian Beier walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
73' Here is a change. Umut Tohumcu is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim).
73' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Bayer Leverkusen! Play can continue.

72' There's a break in play and referee Deniz Aytekin must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayer Leverkusen using VAR. This could be interesting!
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) coming on for Piero Hincapie.
71' Surely that's handball by one of the Hoffenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

71' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.

70' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Oliver Baumann sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
64' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Deniz Aytekin stops the game and makes a call.
64' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
63' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) comes to nothing.
62' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

62' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
58' That will be all from Jonas Hofmann who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
58' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) replaces Andrej Kramaric.
55' A bullet header by Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
55' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
55' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

55' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.

52' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) latches onto a precise cross from the free kick and produces a header at goal from the penalty spot, but his attempt low towards the middle of the target fails to beat Oliver Baumann, who makes a decent save.
52' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick.
50' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
48' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
45+2' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
44' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.

43' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Oliver Baumann thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
42' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
42' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
39' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
39' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Wout Weghorst laid the ball off to Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
33' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:0.
27' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hoffenheim.
24' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Surely that's handball by one of the Hoffenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
21' Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim).
19' Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
18' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
17' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
16' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
13' The referee blows his whistle as Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) was too aggressive in his challenge.

11' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Oliver Baumann pulls off an easy save.
8' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Deniz Aytekin saw the whole situation.
7' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
6' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
3' Hoffenheim are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half has just begun.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
Deniz Aytekin is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
